title: Ultra Trail de l'île de Madère — palmarès et records
claims: MIUT was first held in 2008 and its original 115 km course was fixed in 2013.
Jim Walmsley's 12:58:14 and Courtney Dauwalter's 14:40:35 are the fastest recorded Legend times on the 115 km course.
The 2025 winners were Paul Cornut-Chauvinc in 12:54:52 and Katie Schide in 14:20:56.
The 2026 winners were Vincent Esmiol in 12:48:03 and Katharina Hartmuth in 14:54:59.

verification.note: 2026-11-20 直读公开历届表，作为 B 层纪录来源；2026 冠军与官方成绩页交叉核对。
